correctness.rationale: For x=exp(-gamma-ac), a=pi/sqrt(6), the exact outside mass exceeds 1-exp(-x)>x/(1+x); integration of the Gaussian density bounded by t/c times itself gives T_N(c)<2 phi(c)/c. For their bounds' ratio R(c), (log R)'=c+1/c-a+ax/(1+x)>2 on [3,infinity). At 3 the lower bound exceeds 1/244 by gamma<1, a<4/3 and e<3, while the Mills upper bound is smaller than exp(-9/2)/3<1/244 since 134217728>2187*244^2 and e>8/3. This proves R(3)>1 for the bounds themselves, not just an ordering of the true tails at 3. The Gumbel left tail is negligible relative to exp(-gamma-ac), and the Gumbel right tail and the normal Mills equivalent give the stated asymptotic including its prefactor. Continuity and the opposite strict sign at radius one from Sun–Hu–Sun give at least one crossing in (1,3), not uniqueness. Bibliographic correction: the one-sigma result is in arXiv:2304.11459v2, Sec. 2.2, Theorem 2.2, not v1 cited in the record; the mathematical premise itself is supported.
